About Acme Robotics

Acme Robotics builds autonomous mobile robots for warehouse fulfilment. Our fleet management platform lets operations teams deploy, monitor and coordinate hundreds of robots from a single dashboard. We work with third-party logistics providers and retail distribution centres across North America and Europe, and our robots have completed more than four million picks since 2021.
